chunks: Aban, from Yaqoub ibn Shu'ayb, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

Ali (peace be upon him) tightened a glimmering belt around his abdomen on the Day of Jamal, which Jibraeel (peace be upon him) had descended with from the sky, and the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) used to tighten it around his abdomen whenever he wore the armour.

key_terms.عِقَال: Belt or cord used to secure garments or armour

ai.seo_question: What was the origin and nature of the belt worn by Imam Ali and the Prophet?
ai.summary: This hadith highlights the continuity of divine favor (barakah) from the Prophet to Imam Ali by identifying the glimmering belt (iqal) used by Ali on the Day of Jamal as the same one Jibraeel brought from heaven for the Prophet to wear with his armor. In Shia tradition, this physical link underscores Ali's unique status as the inheritor of prophetic spiritual authority and his readiness for battle, particularly in the conflict with Aisha, Talha, and Zubayr.

en.hubeali: H 14960 – Aban, from Yaqoub Bin Shuayb, who has said: Abu Abdullahasws has said:

‘Ali<sup>asws</sup> tightened a glimmering belt around his<sup>asws</sup> abdomen on the Day of Al-Jamal which Jibraeel<sup>as</sup> had descended with from the sky, and the Rasool Allah<sup>saww</sup> used to wear it around his<sup>saww</sup> abdomen whenever he<sup>saww</sup> wore the armour’.
en.sarwar: 513. Aban, from Al-Fazeyl Bin Yasaar, who has said:

Abu Ja’far (a.s.) has said: ‘Usman said to Al-Miqdad (ar), ‘By Allah (azwj), stop insulting me or I will return you (ar) to your (ar) First Lord (azwj)’. He (a.s.) said: ‘So when the death presented itself to Al-Miqdad (ar), he (ar) said to Ammar, ‘Make it reach to Usman from me (ar) that I (ar) have returned to my (ar) First Lord (azwj)’.
